scope: Prospective efficient-learner extension of the same Gaussian Markov TD model; no deep-MARL claim.
fixed_baseline: Full-budget, no-calibration GLS with true-context optimal spacing at each fixed q.
gains: Causal innovation gains minimize exact quadratic Lyapunov risk; they attain the Gaussian linear-unbiased information bound. This inherited identity is not claimed as novel.
stopping_rule: Preserve all cells and thresholds; any failed mandatory gate stops confirmation under this configuration. No CPU result establishes nonlinear PPO transfer.
paired_unit: Seed aggregate over the same 360 public contexts. Fixed-q selection is an analytic public-population oracle, not calibration-outcome selection.
